limitations: This is a bounded security investigation, not a full audit or safety certification.
Only recognized proxy patterns and selected state are inspected.
Static opcode/address candidates do not prove executed calls.
Current code matching cannot establish equivalence of all runtime behavior.
Local hash matching alone is not independent historical authenticity.
A historically authentic report can describe a contract that has since changed.
Current matching covers code, recognized implementations, permissions and owner getter, not every storage slot or dependency.
